fields.headline: GREENSOMES.
fields.body: Foursomes with a second chance off the tee.

fields.headline: BOTH DRIVE, THEN PICK.
fields.body: Both partners drive, the side chooses the better ball, then alternate shots from there until it is holed.

fields.headline: 60 AND 40.
fields.body: The side plays off 60% of the lower course handicap plus 40% of the higher, and shots are given off the difference between the sides.

fields.headline: IN THE CATALOGUE.
fields.body: Pick greensomes on any session and the 60/40 blend is applied at the draw. Every setting carries a line saying what it does, so nobody argues about the maths at the turn.
